status.heading: Workspace status
status.inspectionRequired: Inspect or Reinspect this package before running it. Nothing is bound automatically.
status.helpHint: Read explanations for the current page.
status.executionHelp: Review this workspace's captured operation, outcome and cleanup independently of its next-run settings and retained logs.

captureCache.enable: Cache new native captures on this machine
captureCache.privacy: Off by default. Original PNGs stay outside packages and backups. Loading a cached image restores history, not live capture authority.

recognition.heading: Recognition authoring
recognition.intro: Load an authorized PNG or explicitly capture a selected window, then set up game content and regions. Try OCR or template recognition and save selected crops with metadata. No package code or game input runs here.
recognition.captureHelp: Each capture keeps its own geometry and regions. Switching unloads the original image; load a PNG explicitly for the selected capture. Save writes all capture metadata.
recognition.migration: Legacy single-image metadata is loaded as one capture. Explicit Save migrates it to version 2 without changing region or asset references.
recognition.discardPixelsHelp: Switching or replacing an image releases its original pixels. The selected crops will not be saved. All capture metadata and already saved assets remain.
recognition.previewHelp: Draw regions in the preview. Confirmed game content is reused for same-size scene images and saved with the package. Use Game content if placement changes, even at the same size. Closing the preview keeps every draft.
recognition.confirmHelp: The image dimensions or content setup changed. Adjust game content if needed, then explicitly confirm its geometry before trials, crops or Copy.
recognition.noFrame: No image loaded. Load a saved PNG to define the game content and regions.
recognition.noFrameSaved: No image loaded. Saved definitions stay editable and saved OCR crops can be rechecked; load a PNG for frame trials, crops and geometry changes.
recognition.limits: PNG up to {input} MiB and {inputPixels} pixels; crops up to {crop} MiB and {cropPixels} pixels. Images are never resized.
recognition.undoHelp: {count} of at most {limit} metadata steps kept
recognition.noDefinitions: No definitions. Drag on empty content in the preview window to add an OCR region.
recognition.noDefinitionsFrame: No definitions. Load a PNG, then drag on the image in the preview window to add one.
recognition.trialFor: Include {name} in OCR trial and checked OCR Copy
recognition.noSelection: Select a definition in the list or in the preview window.
recognition.name: Name
recognition.kindHelp: OCR is the default. Choose template only where OCR does not suit; no automatic fallback between them is configured.
recognition.templateNeedsCrop: A template needs a saved pattern PNG before runtime Copy: choose Save crop and save.
recognition.patternChanged: The pattern area differs from the saved PNG. The saved PNG stays until you save a replacement crop.
recognition.referenceTextHelp: A note for Script authors, copied as an escaped comment beside this zone in checked OCR Copy. It is never sent to the engine, matched or waited for, and trials never compare against it.

issues.name: Enter a name (at most 512 bytes, no NUL).
issues.region: The region is empty or outside the content.
issues.search: The search area is empty or outside the content.
issues.searchSmall: The search area is smaller than the pattern.

notices.confirmBeforeReplace: Confirm the current content geometry or explicitly discard recognition changes before replacing the image or switching captures.
notices.definitionLimit: At most 256 definitions can be kept.
notices.documentLimit: Recognition metadata would exceed 256 KiB; the edit was not applied.
notices.expectedLimit: Script reference text is limited to 4 KiB (UTF-8); the edit was not applied.
notices.nameLimit: Names are limited to 512 bytes and cannot contain NUL; the edit was not applied.
notices.invalidGeometry: That geometry is empty or outside the content; it was not applied.
notices.staleEdit: The preview edit was made on an older state and was not applied. Try again.

blocks.noDocument: No recognition metadata yet. Load a PNG to start.
blocks.noCapability: The engine's grouped OCR limit is unknown. Check the engine first.
blocks.overLimit: More zones are selected than the engine accepts in one request. Unselect some; nothing is split or dropped.
blocks.mixedKinds: Select only OCR definitions, or exactly one template.
blocks.templateSingle: A template trial takes exactly one template.
blocks.noSample: Select an OCR definition with a saved crop.
blocks.invalid: Fix the definitions marked with a problem first.
blocks.otherCapture: Another capture still holds pending crop pixels. Select that capture and Save it, or discard explicitly.
blocks.rights: Saved template PNGs need a license, an author and your review.
blocks.cropFrame: The selected crop's original image is unavailable. Return to its capture or reselect it on a confirmed current image.
blocks.kind: This snippet does not match the definition's recognition kind.
blocks.templateUnsaved: Save the template's PNG, metadata and rights before copying runtime source.

recognition.trialHelp: Trials run the fixed engine child on the loaded image or a saved crop only. Package code never runs; results are not saved.
recognition.capabilityMissing: The engine has not reported its grouped OCR limit. Trials stay unavailable; editing continues.
recognition.sampleHelp: Recognizes the complete saved crop without the original image. It does not prove placement in a current frame.
recognition.textContract: Text as returned by the engine (Unicode NFC, trimmed by the engine); this editor applies no further normalization.

freshnessHelps.fresh: This trial matches the definition, image, content and OCR configuration as they are now.
freshnessHelps.stale: Inputs changed after this trial; it does not describe the current definition.
freshnessHelps.historical: Retained from before this editor state; not attributed to the current inputs.

recognition.scoreUnavailable: No candidate was returned, so no score exists.
recognition.saveHelp: Saves the metadata JSON, the template manifest and maps, and only the crops you chose, through the package save transaction. The original image is never saved.
recognition.rightsHelp: Required for saved template PNGs; they apply to the generated engine manifest.
recognition.reviewed: I reviewed that these crops may be stored under this license.
recognition.copyHelp: Current mado-host-v1 source goes only to the clipboard; package files and previously pasted code are never changed. Paste the Game content setup once, before the grouped OCR snippets, and copy the setup again after Game content edits.
recognition.copySetupHelp: Defines recognitionBasis from the confirmed Game content geometry. It needs no checked or selected definition and runs no recognition.
recognition.copyOcrHelp: Every checked OCR Trial row, independent of Selected definition, in one scan_ocr_zones request that uses recognitionBasis. The snippet releases its observation; the scan result is a plain snapshot. It has no waits, text matching, input or logging.
recognition.copyTemplateSelect: Select a template definition to copy its recognize snippet.
recognition.noTrialFor: No trial result for this definition; copied source is unverified.
recognition.copyObsoleteHelp: The copied selection or definitions changed, or for a template also the image or its geometry. Copy again for updated source; pasted code is not changed.
recognition.copySetupObsoleteHelp: The Game content geometry changed. Copy the setup again and replace the pasted recognitionBasis; pasted code is not changed.
recognition.copyGeometryOnly: Geometry only: this setup is not a recognition result and is never verified by a trial.
recognition.copyVerified: At Copy time, every included region had current successful trial observations. This does not verify later frames or reference text.
recognition.copyUnverified: At Copy time, at least one included region lacked current successful trial observations (unverified).
recognition.basis: Geometry basis: image {frameWidth} × {frameHeight}, content x {x}, y {y}, {width} × {height}. Coordinates are bound to this basis.
recognition.previewHelpHint: Read instructions for the selected preview tool.
recognition.previewCloseFailed: The preview could not be closed
recognition.previewNoOwner: No Edit session shares recognition state. Close this window.
recognition.previewNoFrame: No image yet. Use the capture controls above, or load a PNG in Edit.
recognition.previewImageFailed: The preview image could not be read
recognition.previewSendFailed: The action could not be sent to the Edit window
recognition.inspectEmpty: Click the image to select a pixel
recognition.inspectSwatch: Illustrative color over a transparency checkerboard
recognition.inspectHelp: Click anywhere in the image, including outside Game content. With the image focused, arrows move one original pixel (also with Shift); Escape clears. Inspect does not edit geometry. X/Y start at zero at the original top-left. Channels are decoded RGBA8 before browser compositing, not monitor color or encoded sample depth. RGB hex excludes alpha; the checkerboard swatch is illustrative. The reduced preview may omit the selected source pixel. Zoom and scroll preserve the selection; changing the source, starting acquisition, leaving Inspect or closing Preview clears it. After a failed read, select a pixel again explicitly.
recognition.contentDetectAmbiguous: Several boundaries look equally plausible. No candidate was selected; adjust Game content manually.
recognition.contentDetectApproximate: Approximate original-frame coordinates: this preview was downsampled. Its edges cannot prove single-original-pixel accuracy; review and adjust before confirming.
recognition.contentDetectEmpty: No supported boundary and aspect-ratio combination found. Adjust Game content manually or try another ratio.
recognition.contentDetectFailed: Detection failed or the preview image is not ready. Retry or adjust Game content manually.
recognition.zonesHelp: Drag empty content to add a region. Drag a region to move it; drag its edges or corners to resize. Arrow keys nudge the selection, Delete removes it, ⌘Z undoes.
recognition.contentHelp: One-time setup or geometry correction: drag the content edges to exclude black bars, or draw a new rectangle. Committing returns to Regions; confirm changed geometry in the Edit window.
recognition.newFrameGeometry: The new frame has different dimensions. The previous Game content rectangle and selected crop originals are retained; reset geometry explicitly before editing this frame.
recognition.rebaseFrame: Reset Game content to the full new frame
recognition.surfaceLabel: Image with the content rectangle and recognition regions

target.heading: Target
target.introduction: Machine-local macOS configuration for this Tab and package. Save and Check inspect filesystem metadata only; they never start programs, find windows, capture, send input, change focus, or request permissions.
target.introductionHint: Configure this workspace's local target without starting or controlling it.
target.noDeclaration: This package declares no target. Existing controlled and replay execution is unchanged. Add target intent to the package manifest and Reinspect to configure it.
target.packageTitle: Exact title required by the package
target.localTitle: A local exact window title is required.
target.incompatible: The retained binding does not match this declaration. It is not applied to this form. Save explicitly replaces it after validation; Remove clears only the retained local binding.
target.undeclaredRetained: This package no longer declares a target, so the retained binding is not applied. Remove clears only the retained local binding. Replacing it requires declaring a target in the package manifest again and Reinspecting.
target.savedResolution: Saved configuration and canonical locations · private details
target.unloaded: Saved target configuration has not been read.
target.passed: Configuration metadata passed · not connected or authorized
target.changed: Canonical resolution changed · review and Save required
target.failed: Target action failed · saved data and draft retained
target.earlier: This result belongs to an earlier draft; it does not check the current edits.
target.saved: Save completed. Active runs are unchanged.
target.removed: Binding removed. Programs, package files and profiles were not deleted.
target.refreshFailed: Saved-view refresh failed. A completed Save or Remove was not rolled back. Retry the read below, not the completed mutation.
target.refreshPending: Refreshing this owner's saved view. Draft edits are retained.
target.readFailed: Saved target configuration could not be read. Stored bytes and local edits were preserved.
target.conflict: The saved record changed. Reload to reconcile its latest revision before another Save or Remove. Reload keeps your draft; Discard loads the latest compatible saved values.
target.confirmRemove: Remove only this Tab/package's saved binding? This does not delete the installation, package or profiles.
target.active: Save, Check and Remove are unavailable during an active run or OCR Check. Draft edits and navigation do not alter the operation.
target.privacy: Paths and literal arguments are private local configuration, not portable profile values. Do not enter credentials or secrets; there is no automatic secret detection.
target.requiredFields: Required: game kind and path, and exact window title. For capture-only use, leave all input fields blank. To configure input, complete route, focus policy and click hold; process-directed input also needs a pointer mode. A separate launcher needs its kind and path. Check and Save stay disabled until the configuration is valid.
target.launcherHelp: Unchecked means the game itself. A launcher is validated separately and never substitutes for the actual game.
target.argumentsHelp: One field is one argument, including an empty field. Up to 32 arguments; 1024 UTF-8 bytes each, 8192 total. No shell parsing or expansion.
target.argumentsHint: Each field is one literal argument; no shell expansion.
target.reorderHelp: Drag this handle to reorder, or focus it and use the Up/Down arrow keys.
target.windowHelp: No wildcard, regex or title-only process identity. A package-required title cannot be changed locally.
target.policy: Input policy · used only by an approved Native Start
target.policyHelp: Leave all input fields blank for capture-only use. An input route is never invented for a selected window. System input requires an already focused target; AppKit background requires process-directed input with focus preserved. No policy grants permission or changes focus.
target.policyHint: Choose input constraints for a separately approved Native Start.
target.saveHint: Save local target configuration after checking filesystem metadata.
target.checkHint: Check filesystem metadata without saving or starting the target.
target.runningHint: Read whether the saved game application is running; never launch it.
target.reviewHelp: Review these private locations deliberately. Reviewed Save resolves them again and refuses if they changed again. This approves configuration only, not execution.
target.packageBundleId: Required game application ID · launcher independent
target.runningHelp: Available only for a compatible saved application bundle with an unchanged settled draft. Checks the actual game, never its launcher. Manual paths and configuration Check/Save remain separate.
target.runningCancelled: Check cancelled for this view. An OS read may still be finishing.
target.runningFailed: Running-application check could not complete · saved configuration unchanged

runningStatuses.ambiguous: Multiple or unverifiable candidates · no unique correspondence

evidenceKinds.exact_path: Exact installed executable path · signed-code comparison
evidenceKinds.signed_application: Matching signed application and running architecture · different path

target.exactLimit: Exact executable-path correspondence is not publisher authenticity or proof of launch history.
target.signedLimit: Signed application/build corresponds, but the originating installed copy cannot be identified. An indistinguishable copy may have been launched.
target.unsignedLimit: Path-only correspondence. The running build is not guaranteed to equal the file currently installed at that path.
target.runningLimits: This is a historical observation, not a live connection, window or readiness check, permission, or native Start authority. The process may have exited.
target.diagnosticTruncated: Private diagnostics were truncated to the display limit of 64 KiB.

fieldErrors.path: Enter an absolute path, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.
fieldErrors.text: Enter a nonempty exact title, at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.

settings.heading: App settings
settings.introduction: Shared across all workspaces. Your workspace stays where it is. Opening this dialog performs no native operation.
settings.packagesHelp: Create and Duplicate put each new package in this sources folder under its Package ID. Changing it never moves existing packages or changes the active Edit session. Open still accepts an existing external package directory.
settings.packagesRootHelp: Blank uses sources beside settings.json. Enter an absolute directory without parent traversal. Save validates the location but creates nothing; only Create or Duplicate creates a missing folder. Private configuration directories, links and nested package destinations are refused.
settings.packagesSavedRoot: Saved sources folder for future packages
settings.backupsHelp: Back up now writes one versioned ZIP named app.config.<Unix seconds> containing settings.json, every saved open and closed Tab and package .config file, unassigned historical profile sources and any opaque identity-migrations.config bytes, exactly as stored. Preserved old bytes are not activated or converted. Package payloads, logs and earlier backups are excluded; the archive is not encrypted.
settings.backupDirectoryHelp: Saved with the other App settings by Save changes. Blank means the default backups directory under the selected root. The host creates a private directory when missing and refuses unsafe or linked ones.
settings.backupNowHelp: Uses the saved destination now, independent of Save. Stop stays available while the archive is written.
settings.backupUnsaved: The backup directory edit above is unsaved: this snapshot uses the saved destination and does not save the edit.
settings.backupPending: Writing snapshot… its result is kept even if this dialog closes.
settings.backupFailed: Snapshot did not complete · check the diagnostic before retrying
settings.saveFailed: Previous stored settings are unchanged. Correct the draft and save again.
settings.unsaved: Unsaved changes · Cancel or Escape discards them
settings.languageHelp: Language changes only after Save succeeds. Selecting a language does not preview it. Cancel keeps the saved language.
settings.notificationsHelp: Short-lived cards at the bottom right. Blocking failures and cleanup outcomes remain on the Run page regardless of cards.
settings.visibleHelp: Older cards leave the stack immediately; every event stays in the relevant log.
settings.timeoutHelp: The timer pauses while you hover or focus a card. Cards already shown keep the duration they were created with.
settings.successHelp: Warnings and errors are never suppressed by this switch.
settings.editorHelp: Completion preferences apply only after Save. Saving keeps the current editor, unsaved source, selection and history.
settings.completionAutomaticHelp: Off prevents new automatic suggestions. Complete and Ctrl+Space still work, and an open completion session continues as you type or backspace.
settings.completionDelayHelp: 0–1000 ms · default 100. Waits after the latest eligible typing before opening, not for explicit commands or updates to an open session. Provider processing takes additional time.
settings.logsHelp: One bounded buffer shared by every workspace and application log page. File logs and delivery queues are unaffected.
settings.saveError: Settings were not saved · draft kept

invalid.one: Correct {count} invalid field before saving · Cancel or Escape discards all edits
invalid.other: Correct {count} invalid fields before saving · Cancel or Escape discards all edits

invalid.otherCategories: Correct {count} invalid fields in {categories} before saving · Cancel or Escape discards all edits

settings.wait: Save waits until “{reason}” settles · Cancel or Escape discards unsaved edits
settings.logLimitHelp: 1–10000 · default 1000 · saved limit {limit}. Lowering it trims the shared history immediately after Save.

environment.noDescriptor: None selected · initialization could not be checked

environment.authority: A check never admits a run. Start captures and revalidates every file again, including same-path replacements; no path is watched.
environment.saveFirst: Save an OCR environment to enable Check.
environment.dirty: Check reads saved settings only. Save changes first.
environment.active: Another operation owns the runner until its terminal outcome is recorded.
environment.introduction: Machine-local, saved in App settings, never in portable profiles. Save validates settings structure; Check uses saved settings and the selected recorded corpus.
environment.modelPlaceholder: Absolute path to the accepted model files
environment.runtimePlaceholder: Absolute path to the pinned ONNX runtime library
environment.libraries: Reviewed native library paths · one per line
environment.librariesPlaceholder: Explicit non-system libraries the engine child may load
environment.librariesHelp: Enter 1–64 absolute paths; blank lines are ignored. Rust canonicalizes them and derives file and SDK identities during Check and again on every Start. Listing a path is not an audit of every loaded image.
environment.manualHelp: Keep existing paths or enter externally installed runtime and reviewed library paths here. Only the fixed supported model bytes are accepted.
environment.blank: Saving a blank draft stores no OCR environment.
environment.saveHelp: Save changes below writes this environment with the other App settings.
environment.checkHelp: Validates files, then initializes the engine against the selected corpus without evaluating package code. Stop applies.
environment.noCorpus: Without a descriptor, Check validates files and reports the missing corpus; it cannot claim initialization.
environment.noChecks: No check has completed in this session.

ocrSetup.heading: OCR resources
ocrSetup.introduction: Download the verified model set and follow the native dependency guidance. Opening settings does not inspect files, download resources, or start the engine.
ocrSetup.commandsHelp: Instructions only. Copy puts this text on the clipboard; the application never runs commands or installers.
ocrSetup.cleanupHelp: Incomplete cleanup keeps setup and other operations blocked. Restart the application before retrying; keep the diagnostic if the failure recurs.
ocrSetup.previous: Earlier setup operation · status only. Its result will not fill this draft. Run a new Recheck when setup is available.
ocrSetup.unavailable: This job's progress is unavailable. No other job's result is used. You can cancel this setup or close settings; reopen and Recheck after it settles.
ocrSetup.noResult: Recheck ended without a resource result. Recheck again; no settings have been applied.
ocrSetup.downloaded: Downloaded files passed verification and stay installed. Recheck to resolve the complete environment; nothing has been saved or initialized.
ocrSetup.busy: Resource setup or its incomplete cleanup blocks other operations.
ocrSetup.saving: Wait until settings finish saving before setting up resources.
ocrSetup.stale: The draft changed since this Recheck started. Recheck again before using its result; your edits have not been overwritten.
ocrSetup.applied: The resolved OCR paths were added to the draft. The dialog's Save status determines whether they are persisted; Check uses saved settings.
ocrSetup.proposal: The required resource files resolved. Use in settings fills the OCR draft only; Save persists it. Engine initialization has not been checked.
ocrSetup.recheckHelp: After external installation, enter runtime/library paths under Manual paths and Recheck. A blank model root uses the managed verified model set.
ocrSetup.missing: Some resources remain missing or incompatible. Follow the item guidance, enter the reviewed dependency paths under Manual paths, then Recheck.
ocrSetup.retained: Cancel setup stops only its pending work. Closing settings discards unsaved edits; neither removes complete downloaded files. Setup does not initialize the engine. Save, then Check with a recorded corpus.

run.validateHint: Check the current profile draft, not the saved package.
run.introduction: Edits affect the next operation, never the active snapshot. Every Start revalidates files; no check or inspection is reused.
run.introductionHint: Configure the next operation without changing an active run.
run.startHint: Submit these settings; files and values are checked again at Start.
run.diagnosticHelp: Full diagnostics are available through explicit private disclosure on the Execution page.
run.noOperations: No operation for this workspace yet
run.replaySummary: Recorded corpus, real recognition, controlled sink
run.controlledSummary: Fixture observations, no live capture or input
run.nativeSummary: Saved application, live capture and input, approved for each Start
run.confirmReinspect: Discard unsaved profile and target edits and reinspect this package?
run.reinspectBlocked: Inspection is refused while this workspace owns an operation
run.reinspectHelp: Reinspection validates inventory, schema, and static dependencies without executing package code; it increments the selection revision and resets the draft.
run.reinspectHint: Recheck saved package files without running code, then reset the draft.
run.packageDirectoryHint: Choose the local package directory used for inspection.
run.profilesError: Some saved profiles could not be loaded
run.profilesHelp: Compatible profiles and new drafts remain available. Stored files were not modified. Restore compatible data, then reinspect.
run.rejectedHelp: Some saved profiles are incompatible with the inspected schema and stay unusable until recovered. Reinspect saves the compatible ones automatically and opens repair for the rest; nothing is written until then.
run.legacyHelp: Explicitly copies compatible current-XID profiles from profiles/*.json into this workspace's inspected package store, keeping their IDs, values and source bytes. Unassigned sources remain inactive until imported; old IDs are refused, never converted. Files are processed in sorted order and Import stops at the first fault, retaining the actual imported and already-present IDs shown below. Conflicting destinations are never overwritten; retry after eligible recovery recognizes identical entries. Other workspaces keep independent stores.
run.legacyHelpHint: Old IDs are refused, never converted; conflicting destinations are never overwritten.
run.legacyHint: Import compatible current-XID profiles without changing their source files.
run.staleSchema: Stale schema identity. This profile cannot be rebound or run.
run.presetHelp: Choosing a preset creates a new draft. Save it with a name to keep it.
run.optionsHelp: Missing top-level fields use schema defaults. Explicit objects are never recursively filled. Backend validation reports exact field paths.
run.optionsHint: Set values against the inspected package schema.
run.replay: Replay · recorded corpus, real recognition, controlled sink
run.native: Native · saved application, live capture and input after per-Start approval
run.nativeUnavailable: Native · unavailable on this platform or build
run.descriptorPlaceholder: Absolute path to a replay descriptor JSON
run.nativeHelp: Native attaches to the saved game, or conditionally launches it, only after this package's readiness() requests startup. Capture, input, launch and exit recovery are separate approvals for this Start. Relevant edits, leaving this workspace and every Start withdraw them; none is saved. Native never requests activation, changes its route, requests permissions or sends input outside Workflow.
run.nativeCapabilityError: Native availability could not be read
run.nativeWorkflowHelp: Enter whole seconds from 1 to {maxSeconds}. The host default is {defaultSeconds} seconds for each new or reopened binding. This draft is not saved. Every edit withdraws capture, input, launch and recovery approvals; review again before Start. Other limits are unchanged.
run.nativeWorkflowError: Enter a finite whole number from 1 to {maxSeconds} seconds before approving or starting. Blank, fractional and out-of-range values are not accepted.
run.nativeBudgetHelp: Each attempt keeps these stage ceilings. Initial startup starts at reservation; a recovery's startup starts at its admission. Readiness starts at capture ready and Workflow at explicit Ready. Unused stage time never carries over, and polling never extends the original whole-run deadline.
run.nativeBudgetHint: Stage ceilings and the whole-run deadline remain finite.
run.nativeStartupHelp: Native acquires no target and launches nothing until readiness() calls host.call('target_start', {}). The Script then polls host.call('target_status', {}) and uses the bounded wait host call between polls. Capture ready means only that the game window can be captured: the Script's own image and OCR criteria decide when the game is ready, and input is possible only in Workflow after the Script returns Ready. A click on a start screen belongs at the beginning of Workflow.
run.nativeOperationHelp: One line naming the input this workflow may send. This is your reviewed statement, not a script sandbox.
run.nativePostconditionHelp: One line naming what a newer frame must show if the input took effect. A submitted receipt alone is not success.

nativeTextErrors.control: Line breaks, tabs and other control characters are refused.

run.nativeCapture: Approve live capture of the saved application's window for this Start
run.nativeInput: Approve ordered input by the saved route and focus policy for this Start
run.nativeApprovalHelp: Approval becomes available once everything above is ready, and applies only to the request shown here.
run.nativeRecipe: Saved launch recipe · used only after the Script requests startup, launch is approved and the game is confirmed absent

nativeDirectories.os: Defined by macOS for an application-bundle launch
nativeDirectories.refused: Refused for launch: macOS defines the working directory of an application-bundle launch. Remove this directory from the saved target, or leave launch unapproved.
nativeDirectories.parent: The launcher executable's folder · host default

run.nativeForwarding: The separate launcher decides which arguments and working directory reach the game. Native still waits for and verifies the actual saved game, never the launcher.
run.nativeLaunch: Approve one saved-recipe launch per admitted attempt, only if the game is confirmed absent
run.nativeLaunchHelp: Attaching to a running game needs no launch approval and supplies no new arguments. An accepted OS launch may finish after Stop, timeout or failure; automation does not close it or undo it. The game can bring itself to the front, but Native never requests activation or implicitly clicks its start screen.
run.nativeRecovery: Approve at most one recovery after a confirmed game-process exit during Workflow
run.nativeRecoveryHelp: Default off; requires launch approval. After fully verified cleanup, a fresh attempt re-enters this same package's readiness() and workflow() from the beginning, not the interrupted statement. Re-entry can repeat business actions; exactly-once execution is not guaranteed. No game-termination authority is granted. Frame and input-event limits remain aggregate across both attempts. The deadline is (1 + r) × (startup + readiness + workflow) + r × 3000 ms, where r is 0 or 1; settlement cannot renew it.
run.nativeEnvelope: {duration} ms · final cleanup is separately bounded

nativeStatuses.pending: Startup requested · capture not yet available
nativeStatuses.capture_ready: Capture ready · game readiness decided by the Script

nativeFailures.preflight: Preflight stopped before the Script started, so no target was acquired and nothing was launched. Check the reported cause and approvals, then review the request before another Start.
nativeFailures.unrequested: The operation ended before the package's readiness() requested startup with host.call('target_start', {}), so no target was acquired and nothing was launched. Check the reported cause, the package's Readiness and the startup budget, then review and Start again.
nativeFailures.target_discovery: The saved game could not be attached and nothing was launched. Check the saved target, then review and Start again.
nativeFailures.launch_submission: The launch stage did not complete; no retry was made. See the separate launch outcome and check whether the game opened before reviewing another Start.
nativeFailures.waiting_for_process: The actual game process could not be verified. Nothing was launched again. Check the reported cause and running copies before reviewing another Start.
nativeFailures.waiting_for_window: The selected game's exact window could not be bound. Nothing was launched again. Check the reported cause and window before reviewing another Start.
nativeFailures.native_initialization: Native initialization did not complete for the selected game. Check the reported cause, window and input policy before reviewing another Start.
nativeFailures.readinessPending: Readiness ended while startup was still pending, before capture was available. Nothing was launched again. Check the reported cause and the startup budget before reviewing another Start.
nativeFailures.readinessCriteria: Capture was available, but the package's Readiness did not complete successfully. Native does not click a start or idle screen for you. Check the reported cause and the Script's image and OCR criteria against the game screen before reviewing another Start.
nativeFailures.workflow: The workflow failed after Readiness. Input already sent is not rolled back; check the game state before you review and Start again.
nativeFailures.settling: The exited attempt could not settle safely. No successor was admitted; reconcile the retained cleanup outcome.
nativeFailures.recovering: Recovery admission failed. The original exit and cleanup remain retained; no further recovery is available.

nativeCauses.missing: The saved game is not running and launch was not approved. Start the game yourself, or approve launch if absent, then review and Start again.
nativeCauses.ambiguous: More than one running copy matches the saved installation, so none was chosen. Close the extra copies, then review and Start again.
nativeCauses.unverifiable: A running copy could not be verified against the saved installation, so it was not attached. Check the saved installation or restart the game, then review and Start again.

nativeLaunchOutcomes.accepted: macOS accepted this Start's launch request. The game may still be opening or running; this failure did not close it and nothing was launched again.
nativeLaunchOutcomes.acceptedStopped: macOS accepted the launch request before Stop took effect. The game may still finish opening; Stop ended automation only and did not close it.
nativeLaunchOutcomes.uncertain: macOS did not confirm whether the launch request was accepted. The game may still open; nothing was submitted again.
nativeLaunchOutcomes.rejected: macOS rejected the launch request. Nothing was submitted again.

run.descriptorHint: Select the recorded corpus read again by Replay Start and OCR Check.

startUses.replayDraft: Start uses the explicit draft shown here, the saved OCR environment ({environment}), and descriptor {descriptor}.

result.checkHelp: No package module, readiness, or workflow code was evaluated. Engine facts are the child's own report.
result.privateHelp: Script decisions and observation records stay hidden until disclosed below. Full records are not automatically copied to ordinary logs; scripts can explicitly emit bounded messages.

exitReasons.zombie: Verified bound process terminated · awaiting OS reap

truncated.other: Display truncated: {count} more characters are retained by the backend record but not rendered.

disclosureHelp.private: Build metadata, diagnostics, and recognition detail. Rendered here only, bounded to {kib} KiB.

logs.missingHelp: It was evicted from the bounded display buffer or never delivered to the GUI queue. Retained operation outcomes stay on the Run page; file logs are unaffected.
logs.search: Search code, message, source, or run
logs.searchPlaceholder: Search code, message, source, or run ID
logs.empty: No retained events for this scope. Events may still have been evicted from the display buffer or written only to file logs.
logs.order: Newest first · search matches code, message, source, and run only

filtered.one: No retained events match the current filters. {count} event in this scope is hidden by filtering.
filtered.other: No retained events match the current filters. {count} events in this scope are hidden by filtering.

lossHelp.loss: Loss counters are cumulative and independent of this page. Display eviction does not delete file records or change retained results. A filtered or empty page is not a claim that no events occurred.
lossHelp.none: No display eviction, transport loss, or file-output failure has been recorded. Display eviction does not delete file records or change retained results. A filtered or empty page is not a claim that no events occurred.

bootstrap.presentationHelp: Temporary. Applies only until saved settings load; it is not written anywhere and is not read from the failed file.
bootstrap.setupIntro: No App settings exist at the selected location. Initialize writes only settings.json with the choices below. It inspects no package, needs no OCR or target and starts nothing.
bootstrap.recoveryIntro: Configuration is unavailable. Check the stage and cause before retrying; original data and unresolved transaction evidence are preserved. Identifier conversion, profile-schema repair and reset are never automatic.
bootstrap.laterFault: Configuration became unusable after start. The existing Application, polling and Stop stay available; Retry and Restore wait until operations and commands settle.

recoveryOutcome.unsupported: Pending transaction evidence is unsupported by this desktop version. Configuration use and replacement remain blocked; the evidence is preserved, not completed or rolled back.
recoveryOutcome.blocked: Pending transaction recovery cannot be validated. Configuration use and replacement remain blocked; the cause and transaction evidence are preserved. Repair the cause below, then Retry to recheck recovery eligibility.
recoveryOutcome.unfinished: A configuration operation did not finish, so the managed configuration set may be partly replaced. Its current generation has not been confirmed.
recoveryOutcome.rollbackFailed: The configuration operation stopped partway and its automatic rollback did not complete. The managed configuration set may be partly replaced; its current generation has not been confirmed.
recoveryOutcome.rolledBackAutomatically: The operation failed and was rolled back automatically. The exact previous configuration is in place and no operation is pending. Repair the cause below, then Retry.
recoveryOutcome.installedNotReconstructed: The configuration was installed; nothing was rolled back. Rebuilding the application from it failed. Repair the cause below, then Retry instead of applying it again.
recoveryOutcome.rolledBackNotReconstructed: The interrupted operation was rolled back to the exact previous configuration. Rebuilding the application from it failed. Repair the cause below, then Retry.
recoveryOutcome.installedCleanupPending: Installation cleanup did not finish and the current configuration has not been verified. Repair the cause below, then use Complete operation. Retry is unavailable while the operation is pending.
recoveryOutcome.rolledBackCleanupPending: Rollback cleanup did not finish and the current configuration has not been verified. Repair the cause below, then use Roll back operation. Retry is unavailable while the operation is pending.
recoveryOutcome.installedCleanupUnconfirmed: The configuration was installed and no operation is pending, but cleanup reported an error in the cause below. Its completion is unconfirmed. Repair the cause, then Retry instead of applying it again.
recoveryOutcome.rolledBackCleanupUnconfirmed: The operation was rolled back to the exact previous configuration and no operation is pending. Cleanup reported an error in the cause below, so its completion is unconfirmed. Repair the cause, then Retry.

bootstrap.applicationUnavailable: Normal workspace commands are unavailable until the application is ready.
bootstrap.causeHelp: This cause stays until an authoritative Retry, Initialize or Restore resolves it. Editing forms or dismissing notices does not clear it.
bootstrap.repairHelp: Repair the file or permissions externally, or start with --data-dir PATH. The desktop performs no chmod, elevation or hidden fallback.
bootstrap.disclosure: Paths on this screen are disclosed deliberately; they are not written to ordinary logs or notifications.
bootstrap.savedLanguageHelp: Written to settings.json by Initialize. Separate from the temporary display language above.
bootstrap.backupDirectoryHelp: Absolute private directory for configuration snapshots. Blank keeps the default backups directory under the root.
bootstrap.initializeHelp: Creates settings.json only if it is still missing and validates it before publication. Existing directories and data are never cleared.
bootstrap.legacyHelp: A previous default root exists at {path}. Import stages recognized App settings, saved workspaces and package configuration, validating current-XID active profiles and target bindings before publishing a complete result without replacing anything. Active old IDs are refused without conversion. Unassigned profiles/*.json and finalized identity-migrations.config bytes stay inactive and byte-preserved. Logs, backups and unrecognized files stay in the source; the source is never changed.
bootstrap.startFresh: Start fresh without importing the historical root
bootstrap.startFreshHelp: Initialize stays unavailable until you import or confirm a fresh start.
bootstrap.retryHelp: Rereads the actual source after external repair. Unsupported pending evidence stays blocking and is neither executed nor removed. A usable configuration starts one polling owner without restarting the application.
bootstrap.pendingRestoreHelp: A supported version-3 Restore or current-XID profile Import transaction is pending. Ordinary configuration use is blocked until validated recovery settles it. Before commit, complete or roll back explicitly; committed cleanup can only continue in its recorded direction. Unresolved evidence is retained.
bootstrap.unsupportedPendingHelp: Earlier or unknown journals/completion markers and identity-migrations.pending cannot be recovered by this version. Complete and Rollback are unavailable. Retry only rereads the blocker; Exit preserves the journal, preimages, completion marker and pending-write evidence. Do not delete evidence or reset the root to force readiness.
bootstrap.blockedPendingHelp: Complete and Rollback are unavailable until the retained transaction and live files pass validation. Preserve the evidence, repair the reported file or access problem externally, then Retry. A supported version-3 transaction can then be recovered by this version; do not run the old converter on it.
bootstrap.converterHelp: Desktop 0.2.0 does not convert old IDs. Use the retained converter checkout 824d1b7bd001efb025e53a3becb9e5521af677cf on a preserved pre-upgrade copy to convert old active records, import wanted old sources and settle earlier transactions before preparing a separate upgrade candidate. Follow docs/desktop.md. Never run the converter against an evolved 0.2.0 root or remove retained evidence to bypass a refusal.
bootstrap.recoverConfirm: I understand this changes the managed configuration set
bootstrap.snapshotHelp: Back up now writes one versioned ZIP named app.config.<Unix seconds> with settings.json, every saved Tab and package .config file, unassigned historical profile sources and any opaque identity-migrations.config bytes, exactly as stored, even when they cannot be decoded. Preservation does not activate or convert old data. Package payloads, logs and earlier backups are excluded; the archive is not encrypted.
bootstrap.destinationHelp: Blank uses the saved or default destination. This field is never saved and does not repair App settings.
bootstrap.snapshotFailed: Snapshot did not complete · check the diagnostic before retrying
bootstrap.restoreHelp: The archive is validated before replacing saved App, Tab and package configuration. Reserved OS metadata filenames are refused before session disposal, even in older snapshots with valid manifests; the original archive is not rewritten. Clean version-1/version-2 snapshots remain supported. Active profiles and target bindings must already use current XIDs; old active IDs are refused without conversion, and current IDs remain unchanged. Unassigned profiles/*.json and historical ledger bytes stay inactive and byte-preserved; the archive selects ledger bytes or absence without merging. Unsaved drafts, runs, package payloads and logs are not merged. Present configuration requires a matching snapshot clicked in this session.
bootstrap.preimageNone: No current preservation receipt · take a snapshot before replacing existing configuration
bootstrap.restoreConfirm: Replace saved App, Tab and package configuration with this snapshot
bootstrap.discardConfirm: Rebuild the application session and discard unsaved drafts and transient results

block.pendingRestore: Resolve the interrupted configuration operation first.
block.active: Wait for the active operation to settle.
block.command: Wait for the pending command to settle.
block.discard: Confirm session reconstruction and discarding unsaved drafts.
block.authoring: Exit Edit first; the Edit session holds the application until it ends.

bootstrap.actionFailedHelp: The bootstrap state below is authoritative and unchanged by this refusal.
bootstrap.catalogFaults: Saved workspace files that could not be loaded
bootstrap.catalogFaultsHelp: Their bytes were preserved and healthy workspaces stay usable. Repair or restore them; nothing is adopted or deleted.

create.heading: New workspace
create.intro: Choose an internal name and an optional display name. No package, path, OCR or target is required; the workspace is saved as soon as it is created.
create.internalHelp: 1–64 ASCII letters, digits 0–9, _ or -; no spaces. Unique across saved workspaces (case-insensitive), kept exactly as typed and immutable. Names the folder tabs/<name>.
create.displayHelp: Leave empty to use the internal name. Otherwise, enter 1–80 nonblank characters, kept exactly as typed. Duplicates are allowed and shown with the internal name.
create.failedHelp: Nothing was written and no other workspace changed. Correct the names and try again.
create.openLimit: {limit} workspaces are open. Close one before creating another; closed workspaces stay saved.
create.savedLimit: {limit} workspaces are saved. Creation is refused without evicting any of them.

errors.internalLong: Internal names are at most 64 characters.
errors.internalChars: Use only ASCII letters, digits 0–9, _ and -; spaces are refused.
errors.displayBlank: Leave the display name empty or enter a name containing more than whitespace.
errors.displayLong: Display names are at most 80 characters.
errors.displayControl: Display names cannot contain control characters.

reopen.heading: Saved workspaces
reopen.intro: Closed workspaces keep their names and package settings. Reopen issues a fresh session; drafts, results and runs are not restored.
reopen.failedHelp: It stays closed and saved; nothing else changed.
reopen.limit: {limit} workspaces are open; close one to reopen another.

recovery.heading: Rejected saved profiles
recovery.help: Inspection has saved valid reconciliations. Rejected profiles retain their stored bytes until repair or Reset. This panel never runs package code.
recovery.relocationHelp: This directory is not bound and cannot run. Resolve any profile or binding failures shown here, then retry binding. Completed profile saves remain committed; the previous source reference stays saved until binding succeeds.
recovery.bindingHelp: The inspected directory was not published as the saved source: its durable write failed. Nothing runs from it and the previous selection, if any, stays authoritative. Fix the cause named in the workspace action failure, then retry binding.

outcomeStatus.storage_failed: Not saved · record refused or storage failed, original preserved

recovery.outcomesHelp: Listed saves are committed facts. A later refusal, a failed binding or refresh, or a discarded context does not roll them back; any previous source reference is kept until binding succeeds.
recovery.listingFailed: Some profiles are unavailable for recovery
recovery.noneRejected: No profile is rejected in this context.
recovery.allRepaired: No blocking profiles remain. Retry binding to publish this directory as the saved source.
recovery.earlier: This result belongs to an earlier draft; the current edits were not checked.
recovery.resetIncomplete: The current defaults do not form a valid profile. The saved original is unchanged; this unsaved default-based draft needs the values reported below.
recovery.noLongerRejected: This profile is no longer rejected. The edits below were made after the save and are not saved.
recovery.valuesHelp: Remove unknown fields, replace incompatible values and complete required ones. Save validates the whole profile and replaces only this record under its ID and name; nothing is coerced, renamed or filled in for you.
recovery.confirmReset: Reset “{name}” ({id}) in {owner} · package {package}? Only this profile's saved values are replaced with the current top-level defaults; its ID and name are kept. Other profiles, the target binding, Tabs and App settings are not touched.
recovery.retryHelp: Rechecks the captured source and publishes the binding only after its durable write succeeds. Relocation also requires a compatible profile catalog.
recovery.discardHelp: Discarding invalidates this context and any late response to it. Completed profile writes are not undone; any previous source reference stays saved.
recovery.refreshFailed: The profile was saved; refreshing the listing failed afterwards. Nothing was rolled back. Another save, Retry binding or Reinspect refreshes it.

guidance.heading: No package yet
guidance.intro: This workspace is saved with its names only. Create or open a directory package for Edit below, or inspect a package directory to run it. Custom package archives and remote download are not supported.
guidance.where: Edit works on ordinary local package directories. Creating or opening a package never runs its code; exit Edit, then inspect the directory before running it.
guidance.savedHelp: The saved package reference is kept, but nothing is bound in this session. Package-dependent commands are refused until an inspection binds a directory.
guidance.savedUnbound: The saved reference below is metadata, not a current inspected selection; it grants no run authority.
guidance.noSavedBinding: No package is saved for this workspace: the last inspection completed, but its binding was not written. Choose Retry binding or inspect a directory below.
guidance.bindingHelp: Inspection succeeded, but the durable Tab write that binds the directory failed. Nothing runs from it and the saved reference is unchanged. Resolve the failure shown under the inspection form, then retry binding or inspect again.
guidance.confirmInspect: Discard unsaved recovery edits and inspect this directory?
guidance.inspectHelp: Inspection loads the schema and this workspace's saved profiles without executing package code. It binds the directory to this workspace only; other workspaces referencing the same directory keep independent settings.
guidance.packagePlaceholder: Absolute path to a package directory
guidance.inspectRecovery: No package was bound. Correct the directory or package, then Inspect again; the workspace and its saved settings are unchanged.
guidance.unsupportedHeading: Saved package is a custom archive
guidance.unsupportedHelp: This workspace references a custom packaged artifact. The current directory inspector cannot load, unpack or run it; this is not a claim that no package exists. The reference is kept. Inspect a package directory to bind a directory source instead.
guidance.unavailableHeading: Saved package could not be inspected
guidance.unavailableHelp: The saved directory reference is kept and package-dependent commands are refused. Nothing was replaced with defaults. Repair the package or inspect another directory.
guidance.stopHelp: An operation owned by another workspace keeps its Stop in the strip above; nothing on this page starts, stops or retargets it.
guidance.stopHint: The active operation keeps its Stop above; this page cannot retarget it.
guidance.inspectHint: Load package schema and profiles without executing package code.
guidance.applicationStopHelp: An application-scoped environment check, owned by no workspace, keeps its Stop in the strip above; nothing on this page starts, stops or retargets it.

authoring.intro: Edit declared files and saved-image recognition definitions. Save never runs package code; Validate checks one saved revision without running it.
authoring.introHint: Edit package files and recognition definitions without running code.
authoring.authority: Saving never binds or runs the package. Exit Edit, then Inspect or Reinspect it before running.
authoring.filesHelp: Use + to add declared files. Files holds scripts and assets; Metadata opens forms and facts; Recognition edits saved-image regions with a separate preview window. Right-click a file or use its ⋯ button or Shift+F10 to rename or remove it.
authoring.filesHint: Browse files, metadata and recognition; use file menus to rename or remove.
authoring.missingHeading: Unsaved drafts not in the package
authoring.missingHelp: These files are no longer declared. Copy their text or discard the drafts; they cannot be saved.
authoring.diskChangedHelp: The file on disk changed after this draft started. Save replaces the disk text with this draft; Discard changes adopts the disk text.
authoring.binary: Binary asset · {bytes} bytes · not editable as text.
authoring.editorHelp: Tab inserts two spaces when no suggestion is selected; Shift+Tab moves focus out. ⌘Z and ⇧⌘Z undo and redo in this file only; ⌘F searches, ⌘G and ⇧⌘G find the next and previous match, ⌘S saves this file. Ctrl+Space or Complete opens suggestions; arrows select, Enter or Tab accepts and Escape closes.

replacementRefusals.stale: The file or draft changed. Select the current match and try again.
replacementRefusals.ineligible: Replacement is unavailable for this file or during composition.
replacementRefusals.oversized: Replacement would exceed the source or package size limit. Nothing was changed.

authoring.completionScope: Suggestions cover this Script, the SDK and current options schema draft. Imported helper exports, auto-imports and cross-file navigation are not supported. Suggestions do not replace Save and Validate.
authoring.completionHint: Suggest names from this Script, the SDK and the current options schema.
authoring.discardHint: Drop this file's draft and restore its saved content.
authoring.optionsCompletionUnavailable: Options completion unavailable: the current schema is missing, malformed or unsupported. Options are unknown; independent SDK suggestions remain available.

completionStatuses.capped: Suggestions capped; this is not the complete candidate list.
completionStatuses.unavailable: Completion unavailable. Editing and Save remain available; use Complete to retry.
completionStatuses.oversized: Completion exceeds the source or package size limit. No completion edit was applied.

authoring.validationNone: Not validated in this session. Validate checks the saved revision only and never runs package code.
authoring.validationHelp: Validate checks one saved revision without executing package code.
authoring.staleValidation: This result belongs to revision {revision}; the package was saved again since. Validate again before relying on it.
authoring.unsavedNotValidated: Unsaved drafts are not part of any validation. Save them first to include them.
authoring.conflictHelp: Refresh reads the latest disk revision and keeps every unsaved draft; drafts whose disk text changed are marked for deliberate reconciliation.
authoring.refreshFailed: Saved, but the package view could not be refreshed
authoring.refreshRequired: The last file change was committed. Refresh the package view before saving or changing files again; do not repeat the committed change.
authoring.recoverHelp: An interrupted save left recoverable bytes for this package. Recovery establishes a consistent old or new revision and never overwrites files changed by someone else.
authoring.exitHelp: Exit releases the Edit session after pending work settles. Nothing is bound automatically: Inspect or Reinspect the package to run it.
authoring.exitHint: Release the Edit session; inspect the package before running it.
authoring.targetGone: This file is no longer declared. Cancel and choose it again from the current files.
authoring.leaseLostShort: The host no longer reports this Edit session.
authoring.idHelp: Preset or asset ID declared in the manifest.
authoring.moduleHelp: Declared source file this map describes.
authoring.addHelp: New sources start empty, presets with empty options, source maps and JSON assets with minimal JSON. Adding a file does not change imports.
authoring.renameHelp: Renaming updates the manifest only; imports are not rewritten and Validate reports broken ones.
authoring.confirmRemove: Remove {path} from the package and delete its file? The host refuses removing a required entry, schema or preset.

block.pending: Wait for the current Edit action to finish.
block.missing: This file is no longer declared and cannot be saved.
block.binary: Binary assets are not edited as text.
block.manifestDirty: Save or discard the manifest draft first.
block.fileDirty: Save or discard this file's changes first.

authoring.duplicateHelp: Copies the saved declared files into a new directory named by the new package ID in the sources folder. Profiles, target bindings and App settings are not copied and the original is unchanged. Edit then continues on the copy.
authoring.duplicateDestinationPending: Enter a portable package ID to see the destination. The host checks the ID and that the directory is missing.
authoring.leaseLost: The host no longer reports this Edit session. Unsaved drafts are kept here, but Save, recognition actions and Validate are unavailable. Exit Edit to close this view.
authoring.openHelp: Create a TypeScript starter by entering only a Package ID. Its destination is in the saved sources folder from App settings. Or open an existing external directory below. Neither runs package code. Edit owns the application until you exit it.
authoring.openHeadingHint: Neither runs package code; Edit owns the application until you exit it.
authoring.packagePlaceholder: Absolute path to a package directory
authoring.packageIdHelp: 1–128 ASCII letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores; no leading/trailing dot or reserved filesystem name. Example: example.starter.
authoring.packageIdHint: Use a portable ASCII identifier for the new package directory.
authoring.createHint: Create a TypeScript starter in the saved sources folder without running it.
authoring.openHint: Open an existing directory for Edit without executing package code.
authoring.ownerHelp: This workspace owns the Edit session. Return to Edit to continue or exit it.
authoring.resumeHelp: The host holds this workspace's Edit session, but its view is not loaded. Return to Edit reloads the saved files; drafts from before the reload are not available.
authoring.blockedOther: {owner} owns Edit. One Edit session exists per application.
authoring.blockedActive: Wait until the active operation has settled and been cleaned up before entering Edit.
authoring.confirmEdit: Editing requires a fresh package inspection before Run. Discard unsaved profile, target, or recovery drafts and enter Edit?
authoring.startBlocked: Start and OCR Check are refused while {owner} owns Edit.
authoring.stripNote: Start and OCR Check are refused in every workspace until Edit ends.

dirtyHeading.close: Unsaved changes before closing the application
dirtyHeading.closeTab: Unsaved changes before closing this workspace

authoring.dirtyHelp: Save writes file drafts first, then recognition metadata and selected crops, stopping at the first failure. Discard drops these drafts. Cancel keeps Edit, all drafts and the current destination.
authoring.dirtyUnsavable: Some drafts belong to files no longer in the package and cannot be saved. Discard them, or cancel and copy their text.
authoring.treeEmpty: No scripts or assets are declared.
authoring.foldersHelp: Parent folders are created from the path; a folder exists only while it holds a declared file.
authoring.jsonInvalid: This file is not valid JSON.
authoring.jsonKept: The text is kept exactly as it is until you deliberately rebuild the file.
authoring.normalizedNumbers: Editing this file rewrites these numbers in canonical form: {numbers}.
authoring.normalizedDuplicates: Editing this file keeps only the effective last value of these repeated members: {paths}.
authoring.manifestRestore: Discard changes restores the saved manifest.
authoring.manifestNotObject: The manifest is not a JSON object.
authoring.runtimeHelp: Source extensions must match: TypeScript accepts .ts and .js; JavaScript accepts .js and .d.ts.
authoring.entriesHelp: The functions the host calls. Each must be exported by a declared source module; Validate checks the export.
authoring.entryFunctionInvalid: Use an ASCII identifier of at most 128 characters that starts with a letter or underscore.
authoring.helperHelp: Declares the application-approved dependency so sources can import it.
authoring.targetHelp: Portable intent: the application this package is written for. It grants no launch, capture or input authority; each machine binds its own target.
authoring.targetIdInvalid: Use letters, digits, '.', '-' or '_' (at most 128), not starting or ending with '.'.
authoring.targetTitleHelp: Optional. Leave empty to declare no title.
authoring.targetTitleInvalid: Use at most 512 bytes and no control characters.
authoring.targetBundleHelp: Optional, e.g. com.example.game. Leave empty to declare none.
authoring.targetBundleInvalid: Use at most 255 ASCII letters, digits, '.' or '-'.
authoring.declarationsHelp: Changed through the file menus under Files and Metadata; each path opens its own view.
authoring.schemaFieldsHelp: Options a preset can set. Objects nest fields and arrays describe their items.
authoring.fieldNameTaken: Another field already uses this name.
authoring.countHint: A whole number of 0 or more; empty for no limit.
authoring.numberHint: A finite number; empty for no limit.
authoring.enumHelp: Leave the list empty to allow any text.
authoring.nestedDefault: Nested default {value} is validated but never applied; only top-level defaults fill omitted options.
authoring.defaultsHelp: Used when a preset omits the option. Add sets a default and Omit removes it; Validate checks each default against its field.
authoring.defaultsBlocked: Repair the schema problems to edit defaults; existing defaults are kept.
authoring.schemaProblemsHelp: Each repair changes only the named part. Validate reports every remaining problem.
